P. 10</ls>; so ऐश्वर्य˚, धन˚, बल˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Mad, insane. .²3 In rut, furious (as an elephant); जयश्रीरन्तरा वेदिर्मत्तवारणयोरिव <ls>R. 12. 93</ls>. .²4 Proud, arrogant. .²5 Delighted, overjoyed, excited with joy. .²6 Amorous, sportive, wanton. .²7 Excited by sexual desire. .{@-त्तः@} .²1 A drunkard. .²2 A mad man. .²3 An elephant in rut. .²4 A cuckoo. .²5 A buffalo. .²6 The thorn-apple or Dhattūra plant. .{@-त्ता@} Spirituous or vinous liquor.
